integrity: All computations reconstruct graph and complexes from first principles using standard-library Python; no external independence or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Scale-one, two and three integral homotopy types only; degree-two persistence over F2 restricted to r<=6; no homotopy types at higher scales or claims about other fullerenes; literature indexing may miss equivalents.
source_ids: Saleh, On Vietoris-Rips Complexes of the 2-Sphere (2023)
title: Early graph-metric Rips homotopy and two-dimensional persistence of the truncated icosahedron
